> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The added end-to-end loop now exercises all five declared verdict constants on both alert routes, asserts the exact single line written to GITHUB_OUTPUT (including its terminating newline), and couples that assertion to the coarse, redacted stdout produced by the same main() invocation. This makes verdict-specific substitution for insufficient-scope or expiring-soon observable while also detecting dropped, widened, duplicated, or unterminated output writes. I found no remaining diff-scoped correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue.
